workflow.name: Add data or text
workflow.description: The user provides a CSV dataset or process text.

workflow.name: Verify input
workflow.description: The app profiles the dataset or parses the text structure.

workflow.name: Define visual goal
workflow.description: The user states what the graph or diagram should communicate.

workflow.name: Select visual type
workflow.description: The app recommends or confirms a chart or diagram type.

workflow.name: Confirm mappings
workflow.description: The app confirms axes, fields, grouping, filters, and aggregation.

workflow.name: Confirm style
workflow.description: The user may specify colours, titles, highlights, or labels.

workflow.name: Preview and refine
workflow.description: The app creates a preview, applies user refinements, and asks clarifying questions when needed.

workflow.name: Save recipe
workflow.description: The user can save the current visual plan as a reusable recipe skeleton.

workflow.name: Apply recipe
workflow.description: The user can load and apply a compatible recipe to a new dataset.

workflow.name: Export and inspect
workflow.description: The user can export the HTML preview, inspect the environment report, and review troubleshooting guidance.
